creator: brooke_wrightmode
title: 'hormozi-skills' (alexsmedile/hormozi-skills): free Claude Code plugin with one orchestrator, 5 subagents and 17 skills that turn a business idea into an Alex Hormozi-style offer, pricing, objection handling and landing-page copy

tools.name: hormozi-skills
tools.detail: GitHub alexsmedile/hormozi-skills; install: 'claude plugin marketplace add alexsmedile/hormozi-skills' then 'claude plugin install hormozi-skills@hormozi-skills'; badges: Claude Code compatible, platform Claude Code | Codex | Cursor, inspired by Alex Hormozi; MIT license

tools.name: hormozi-orchestrator agent
tools.detail: orchestrator agent in the plugin; writes MARKET_RESEARCH.md, OFFER.md, OFFER_ANGLES.md and other output files

tools.name: /audit-offer, /pricing-strategy, /landing-page-copy
tools.detail: individual skills callable standalone with no prior context

claims: Turns Claude into 'Hormozi': creates offers and copy based on Hormozi's formulas
Includes over 10 skills for offer, pricing strategy, objection handling and landing copy that converts

README: 'One orchestrator, five specialized subagents, 17 skills, 11 output files'; 'describe your business and get a complete offer system -- market research, offer structure, pricing, pitch, hooks, landing page -- written to files in one session'
README problem statement: founders write vague offers that don't convert, price wrong (too low or too high without justification), or skip the sales layer (no hooks, pitch, landing copy)
how_to_steps: Add the marketplace: claude plugin marketplace add alexsmedile/hormozi-skills
Describe your business and run the hormozi-orchestrator agent for the full offer system, or call a single skill such as /audit-offer, /pricing-strategy or /landing-page-copy
Read the generated files (MARKET_RESEARCH.md, OFFER.md, OFFER_ANGLES.md, etc.)
on_screen_only: GitHub README of 'hormozi-skills': 'Turn a business idea into a complete, sellable offer -- using Alex Hormozi's frameworks'; contributors 'claude' and 'alexsm...' (alexsmedile)

Skill table (names partly cut off): '...model: Choose and structure the right business model', '...y: Frame offer as DFY / DWY / DIY tiers', '...duction: Reduce perceived effort in the offer', '...product: Turn rough idea into productized offer', '...page-copy: Generate landing page copy from an existing offer', '...search: Research market pain and demand signals', '...-destroyer: Map and neutralize common objections', '...les: Generate multiple positioning angles', '...strategy: Price anchoring and packaging', '...e: Productize a service business', '...elerator: Increase perceived value', '...ception: Improve how value is communicated'
'Skip the orchestrator and call any skill directly: /audit-offer, /pricing-strategy, /landing-page-copy -- works standalone with no prior context needed'
'System' section: orchestrator -> market = MARKET_RESEARCH.md, offer = OFFER.md + OFFER_ANGLES.md
cta: Comment 'Hormozi' to get the repo link; save and follow

relevance.why: Directly useful for a founder packaging apps/services into offers: a structured, file-producing plugin for pricing, positioning, objections and landing copy, installable via Claude Code's plugin marketplace in two commands.

implement_score.why: Cheap to try (two commands, MIT). Run /audit-offer and /pricing-strategy against each of our products; the orchestrator's MARKET_RESEARCH/OFFER/OFFER_ANGLES files slot into the existing planning docs. Risk: generic 'Hormozi' output and 5 subagents burning tokens.

verify: Does github.com/alexsmedile/hormozi-skills exist, is it maintained (no releases shown), and is the marketplace install command accurate?
Quality of outputs vs. just prompting Claude with $100M Offers concepts; is the 'inspired by Alex Hormozi' content original or lifted?
Token cost of the orchestrator + 5 subagents in one session

gap.what: Different from the liked 'Hormozi AI Skill' (which searches 9,330 transcript passages for cited diagnoses): this is an offer-building workflow plugin (orchestrator + 17 skills producing OFFER.md, pricing, objection and landing-copy files). New repo and new use (packaging/pricing offers).
